gloss: short period of time; brief span

definitions.gloss: short period of time; brief span; short term
definitions.explanation: A relatively brief duration. Often used adverbially with で (in a short period) to describe how quickly something was accomplished.

examples.japanese: {短期間|たんきかん}で{日本語|にほんご}が{上達|じょうたつ}した。
examples.english: My Japanese improved in a short period of time.

examples.japanese: {短期間|たんきかん}の{留学|りゅうがく}でも{得|え}るものは{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Even a short study-abroad period yields many benefits.

examples.japanese: あの{会社|かいしゃ}は{短期間|たんきかん}のうちに{急成長|きゅうせいちょう}を{遂|と}げた。
examples.english: That company achieved rapid growth in a short period of time.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used with で (in), の (of), or のうちに (within) to express that something happened in a short time frame. Frequently appears in business, education, and news contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {短期間|たんきかん}で (in a short period)
- {短期間|たんきかん}のうちに (within a short period)
- {短期間|たんきかん}の{集中|しゅうちゅう}{講座|こうざ} (short-term intensive course)

CONTRAST:
- {長期間|ちょうきかん}: long period of time — the opposite
- {短期|たんき}: short-term — more compact form, often used as a modifier
